candidates.name: Healthchecks.io
candidates.fit: not a replacement for this dashboard
candidates.why: A read-only API key returns check status and flips and omits the ping URL. It cannot list pings or read a ping body, so the worker card (task, plan, identity, state) cannot be recovered without a read-write key. That key can also create, pause, and delete checks. Minimum period and grace are 60 seconds, and more than five pings per minute can be rate-limited. The current display expires after 20 seconds and refreshes every 5 seconds.

candidates.name: Uptime Kuma
candidates.fit: not a replacement for this dashboard
candidates.why: Push monitors are self-hosted. There is no hosted free tier. A monitor running on the Mac cannot distinguish an expired worker from the monitor itself being offline. Hosting it elsewhere adds a second always-on service. A public status page would expose worker text, and a private API still needs a credential on the Worker.
